integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm golden morning light, cozy bedroom, horizontal 16:9, the scene begins exactly as shown in <Picture 1>: the same single East Asian Chinese man about 28, oval face, soft short neatly side-parted black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a DEEP NAVY plain crew-neck short-sleeve tee and matching deep navy home pants, standing beside the centered bed with his right hand already gripping the corner of the quilt, while the East Asian Chinese woman about 26 with messy tousled just-woke-up bed hair in a loose off-white sleep dress lies bundled under the still-flat quilt; the side window casts warm high-saturation golden sunlight and the identities, clothing, colors, and bed layout stay consistent with the frame. The camera performs a doorway push-in, pushing in with small amplitude at slow speed from the door toward the bed. From 0.00 to 00:02.500, the man strides the last step to the bedside, tightens his grip on the quilt corner, and in one motion flings the quilt fully open so the bedding flips up and tosses to the side, going from flat and neat to thrown off; the warm, gently teasing man (S1), in a mid-range male voice, calls out crisply with natural lip-sync: <d>[Chinese] 起床啦——</d>. From 00:02.500 to 00:05.000, the push-in settles as focus shifts to the now-revealed woman (S2); startled by the light and the yanked quilt she rolls over, curls into a tight ball, then lifts one arm to shield her eyes and turns her face into the pillow, going from lying flat to a curled light-shielding pose, mumbling groggily with natural lip-sync: <d>[Chinese] 唔……不要——</d>. From 00:05.000 to 00:06.000, an anchor tail holds on the woman keeping her arm raised with a faint residual squirm before the clip ends.

overall_soundscape: A warm quiet morning room tone with faint birdsong underneath, the sharp flap and rustle of the flung quilt, and the soft shift of bedding as she rolls and curls.
